programs.title: Home Town: Inn This Together
programs.desc: It's a race to finish the hotel; with rooms, an elevator, and the lobby still unfinished, a last-minute disaster threatens the hotel's holiday opening, as well as crucial bookings; and at last, the hotel gets its name.

programs.title: Battle on the Beach
programs.desc: New teams meet their mentors and take on the biggest beach homes yet, starting with the living room; before they can get to work, they must compete in the first challenge of the season to choose their house; the Kalamas join to judge.

programs.title: Renovation Aloha
programs.desc: The Kalamas purchase a fixer-upper in their Kailua hometown, aiming to help a family under a time crunch; the house is in an ideal location, but when permitting issues arise, the duo must find creative ways to keep the renovation on track.

programs.title: Renovation Aloha
programs.desc: In the second phase of their ambitious renovation, Kamohai and Tristyn tackle the remaining three units of their Kalama Street compound; they're hoping for a value high enough to keep the property in the family.

programs.title: Renovation Aloha
programs.desc: When Kamohai and Tristyn buy a family home from Kamohai's cousin, they're torn between honoring generations of Kalama legacy and making the numbers work; some Hawaiian homes carry history that can't be measured in dollars, so the pressure is deeply personal.

programs.title: Renovation Aloha
programs.desc: With rotting floors, rats, and roaming chickens, Kamohai and Tristyn make an offer on the worst house they've ever seen; the deal falls out of escrow and returns at a bargain price, and now, they must transform this total disaster into a dream home.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: David Bromstad hops in the time machine to catch up with past winners; he finds a couple who've expanded their Massachusetts life, a winner who found love twice and turned fixer-uppers into dream homes, and a chic Cleveland bungalow six years later.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: When a Long Island couple relocates to North Carolina, life takes an unexpected turn; after facing a series of setbacks, a turning point comes with an inheritance from her late mother, a timely windfall that offers them the chance to start over.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: An Ohio couple happily starting their retirement wins the lottery again, and this time it's a $5 million score! Now, they're calling on David to find a holiday house in Florida that's near the beach.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: A couple living in her grandmother's tiny two-bedroom house have never had the means to buy their own home -- until they win $1 million on a scratch-off; David searches Akron, Ohio, for a home with a big yard and enough space to host band practice.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.sub_title: Snow Place Like Home in Hub 2.0
programs.desc: A lucky couple's ready to add a second dream hub to their collection! David has already found them a Florida beach hub, and now they're calling on him once again to search for a snowy fairytale cabin in the Pocono Mountains of Pennsylvania.

programs.title: My Lottery Dream Home
programs.desc: After scratching off a $100,000 jackpot, a Sarasota woman is finally ready to find a place of her own; she's dreaming of something spacious near white sand beaches, and she's calling on David to help bust her out of a rental and into a dream home.
